english_title: Proposition 1.2.6: A Sufficient Condition for a Cauchy Sequence
statement_en: If a real or complex sequence $(a_n)$ satisfies $|a_{n+1}-a_n|\leq b_n$ and the series $\sum_{n\geq 1} b_n$ converges, then $(a_n)$ is a Cauchy sequence.
key_techniques: bound tail differences by tails of a convergent series
callout_body: 如果实数(复数)列$(a_n)$满足条件$|a_{n+1}-a_n|\leq b_n$并且$\sum_{n\geq 1}b_n$是一个收敛的级数，那么$a_n$是一个柯西列。
